notes.title: 《I Am Butter》 recently updated!
notes.content:
《I Am Butter》 is a VR platform game, many have loved since its beta version was launched, and we recently launched a new version！
We've fixed it for issues that occurred in previous betas!

- Optimized teaching levels and fixed the issue that English teaching levels could not be cleared
- The handle is optimized for ray and adapts to the handle of different devices
- Perspective optimization, second-level scene optimization
- Player guidance optimization, added animation guidance and text and voice guidance
- Added English subtitles

We hope the new version will bring more fun and enjoyment, and welcome everyone to the world of Butter!

-- Patha Pradipa

notes.title: I AM BUTTER game instructions
notes.content:
I AM BUTTER basic operation Settings (right gamepad) :  
Small jump (click "R1" button for operation) : details adjustment.  Coco love love wriggling in the scene, mainly applied in detail adjustment.  
Medium jump (click "R2" button for operation) : fast movement and accurate judgment.  Mainly used for part of the level subtle clearance.  
Storage jump (long press "R2" button for operation) : accurate time operation control.  Mainly used for distance control and time judgment.  
Direction judgment (handle direction judgment) : You can use the handle somosensory orientation operation, or you can use the remote sensing operation of the left handle.  
In all of butter's levels, we combined the scene and the operation, so that the main character butter needed to use different jumping methods and direction judgment in different situations to pass the level.

notes.title: I AM BUTTER log 01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034160/59761a4632498dc438c74eb460cbd84d1ce72b59.png[/img]
With our new game "I AM BUTTER" in the middle stage of development, some mechanics, gameplay, and background are coming soon. 

I am Butter (hereinafter referred to as Butter) is an ACT+ adventure game developed for VR all-in-one. It allows the player to play Butter from another perspective. 

During the development of Butter, we went through a lot of difficulties and challenges, going back and forth and changing the plan many times, and finally settling on the final shape of the game.

Now let me introduce the basic control of Butter:

[b]Little jumps[/b]: Butter can be tweaked with little jumps. (The effect is to squirm in the scene) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034160/0808585e392d8bf5b53218fb3c04453680ea2df4.gif[/img]

[b]Middle jump[/b]: mainly used for fast movement, and accurate jump. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034160/9da936883ab74f91854046a8afb8f995aacd8727.gif[/img]

[b]Storage jump[/b]: used for long-distance jump. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034160/804a13d0a91fb17bb59b44a14fca21ca8974e061.gif[/img]

[b]Direction[/b]: Use the controller to select the direction. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42034160/89ff018b7f0bda3b869a10773a78c32de17a1c9b.gif[/img]

notes.title: I AM BUTTER is about to launch!
notes.content:
I Am Butter VR is coming soon on Steam!

A 3D VR platformer that applied a new way to control. Let you have a more enjoyable experience!
The overall style of the game belongs to the warm with stimulation, lovely cross-string challenge. It allows the player to experience novelty from another perspective in a familiar setting.

In all levels, we combined the scene and the control, so that the butter needed to use different jumping methods and direction judgment in different situations to pass the level.

In the process of making this game, we draw lessons from many classic games. The overall difficulty of this game is relatively high. We also expect users to realize more personal ability when experiencing our products, especially reaction speed and hand-eye coordination. Therefore, butter is not only a game but also a kind of extreme challenge of sports. It is mainly aimed at users who like to challenge themselves.

If you like it, please add it to your wish list!

Check our Facebook page, and join our group!
